inspiration: One timeline queue of scheduled events keyed by map time, with named types for doors, walls, teleporters, pits and negative 'reaction' events (engines/dm/timeline.h:39-52, 100-102; names only, logic not read). Fits spawn and despawn timers (row 23).

Creature groups own a set of cells, each member has an ordinal per cell, flags mark attacking, side-attacking and any-party-member attacks (engines/dm/group.h:93-95, 107-111, 127-139, 183). Fits many-vs-one target choice and the attacker cap (row 4).
A 44-slot action-by-defence matrix resolves a block or hit with one lookup (engines/dm/timeline.cpp:43; timeline.h:196). Keep the structure; values are game-derived and not recorded here.
Projectiles and explosions in their own module (engines/dm/projexpl.h:41-43), split from melee; a clean split for ranged enemies and burst effects.
Resolution-keyed layout files with scalable variables for line height, font height and borders (gui/themes/common/lowres_layout.stx:22-25). Fits a 375-wide HUD (row 14).
One README per font pack naming the licence per family (dists/engine-data/fonts/fonts/README lines 3-9). Copy the habit for our credits file.
Line-based string tables with blank-line-separated entries and speaker tags (devtools/create_ultima/files/ultima4/text). A simple dialogue format; text must be ours.
Soundfont as a layering aid (GPL v3+ file): an instrument bank for placeholder music; licence is copyleft if shipped, so keep it off our build unless Dom rules otherwise.

briefs.label: Timed reaction tile
briefs.why: A floor tile reacts only when a party member is next to it, so the player reads it before stepping on.
briefs.keep: a timed event on the map timeline; a reaction event fired by proximity
briefs.change: our tile look and sound; reaction delay in our tick units; no pit or fake-wall copy

briefs.label: Creature cluster
briefs.why: A group takes four cells, one slot each, so it reads as one blob with spacing.
briefs.keep: a group that owns cells, one ordinal per cell, one attacking flag
briefs.change: our silhouettes; a tighter or looser cluster; a different slot order and body arrangement

briefs.label: Timed projectile burst
briefs.why: A missile flies on the timeline and bursts on arrival with a short shape, readable at 375 wide.
briefs.keep: projectile as an event on the same timed queue; a burst that lasts a few frames
briefs.change: our colour, burst shape and sound cue; no copy of the module
